lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Let's place your first order. Enter your email, and we'll send you a code.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: That's you signed in. [[slnc 300]] From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your order starts out empty. [[slnc 300]] Add a person to it, and the rest follows from there.

lines.label: add-a-person
lines.said: You can add yourself, or invite a party member to rent alongside you.

lines.label: member-added
lines.said: You are on the order now.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Open a collection to see the items inside it. [[slnc 300]] A collection holds gear of the same kind, so you can compare before you choose.

lines.label: pick-the-dates
lines.said: Now pick your dates. [[slnc 300]] Choose the day you will pick the gear up, then the day you will bring it back. [[slnc 300]] We hold your items for every day in between, and the calendar only offers days we can actually fill. [[slnc 300]] For a single day, tap the same date twice.

lines.label: item-on-the-order
lines.said: Your item is on the order, with its dates and its price. [[slnc 300]] Check both before you carry on.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Now a few questions, so your gear is fitted and waiting before you get here. [[slnc 300]] Your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. [[slnc 300]] We set the bindings from these, which saves you time at the counter. [[slnc 300]] Then agree to the terms and save.

lines.label: order-total
lines.said: Here is your total, with the tax broken out. [[slnc 300]] Take a moment over the dates and the price, because this is the last stop before payment.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

lines.label: order-complete
lines.said: That is your order placed. [[slnc 300]] Your invoice is ready, and your gear will be waiting for you at the store on your pickup day.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Your rental now sits in your order history, so you can come back to it any time. [[slnc 300]] Your details are saved too, which makes your next booking a good deal quicker.

lines.label: logged-out
lines.said: You are signed out. Thank you for renting with Ski Demo, and we will see you on the hill.
